verdict.rationale: Jan runs local GGUF models and serves them through a llama.cpp-powered, OpenAI-compatible API server, so LoRA adapter serving is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence mentions loading LoRA adapters, hot-swapping them, or serving multiple adapters on one base model. The general API server and model import features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
